notes.label: profile C’s split, and how it was got
notes.detail: the viewer puts this page on screen in a median 241.0 ms and held the main thread for 68.0 ms at the longest; the engine alone at that box takes 82.7 ms. About 158.3 ms of the wait is therefore not the engine's render call — under §6's 200 ms for this profile. Two separate page loads subtracted, not one instrumented measurement: pdf.js draws on the main thread inside the same tasks as our layout, so anything finer needs a mark in the render path and none exists.

measures.label: cold page on the harness
measures.detail: 8888 ms to ink on page 6 at 6x via CDP; longest long task 2515 ms since the document opened. A throttled desktop core is not a handset, and §6 also asks for the real-device pass.

notes.label: what profile D is and is not
notes.detail: a Chromium context with a Pixel-class user agent, 412×915 at dpr 3 and CDP CPU throttling — the committed harness, measuring the product’s own mobile ceiling. §6’s separate requirement for a real-device validation is not met by this and is open as tasks #141 and #156.
